checkpoint.title: Out of Wild Zone 1's far gate

events.why: step 62: back onto the road at the catch spots (60, and 100 first when further), by the objective marker. The marker is not on the far gate but past it to its left, behind the zone's fence: a walk at it from 60 was held up at 36 and wandered to 49 inside the zone (console B, 2026-11-13 and 2026-11-14).

step 62: from 60 the far gate's green pillars are straight down the road; walked by hand to its "A Leave" prompt in about 4.7 s, the marker reading 41 there (console B, 2026-11-14). Steered by the pillars on screen (walk_to_zone_gate_entrance, ZoneGateReader), after facing 265 by the minimap (face_heading, L after the turn): the camera read 259 at the prompt with the gate right of centre (x 0.68), and after the catches the gate was off screen once in 3 (console B, 2026-11-14). plza/autostory's walk, about 10 passes on console B 2026-11-14 (3 gate_not_seen); ported over run_to_gate, which never ran here.
step 62: A Leave, out on the street (a plain scene step ends at once on the gate's prompt with the party bar up; console B, 2026-11-10), as plza/autostory passed it (console B, 2026-11-14).

UNVERIFIED, NEEDS CONSOLE: out of the gate the player faces away from it (the facing carries through the gate; console B, 2026-11-10): turn back and step to the gate until its "A Enter" prompt, so the save below stands at a spot with a prompt, which 03.09's start check reads. A gate is entered by its A prompt (03.07's run_to_gate). The step fails when no prompt shows by the leg's end. not planned: Lumiose has no tile grid to plan a route target on.

the user, 2026-11-16: "the save is from where we caught the 5th species, so this might be a reason to manually save? like exit wildzone 1 and manually save". The latest save was the last catch's autosave, wherever in the zone that catch was; X, Save, B here makes it this spot, 03.09's start, with the gate's prompt up.

metadata.source: console B recording, 2026-11-08/09: played step by step from a new game; split from 03.08 at the last catch's autosave, so a checkpoint starts where a save reloads. Starts where that autosave reloads, in Wild Zone 1 at the last catch spot; ends out on the street just through the far gate (user, 2026-11-14), facing the gate's prompt, with a menu save there: 03.09's start (user, 2026-11-16). Start signature: party 5 after the fifth catch, no A prompt, the lead's panel up (console B 2026-11-16: it shows in the zone).
